name: [🏆] Build an ASMR Tower
desc:
⭐ Welcome to "Build an ASMR Tower" where you can build your own SATISFYING OBBY!


How to play:
💰 Buy Satisfying ASMR Tools
🔨 Place them down at your base and Build Your OBBY!
🧐 Earn money with placed blocks
😎 Build the coolest tower and more
-------
Can you build the best OBBY?

Your Own ASMR World!

scripts.title: OP SCRIPT AUTO FARM AND MORE
scripts.features:
· Auto Place Item Walker – Places the selected item under your feet while moving (requires an item in your hotbar and being inside your build zone).
· Pickup All Items Now – One‑click collection of every placed item on your plot (with a confirmation popup to prevent accidents).
· Collect Cash (AFK Stand) – Teleports you to your plot’s CollectZone, freezes you there, and automatically collects cash while you’re away.
· Auto Upgrades – Select which upgrades (Max Placement, Expand Tower, Bank Storage) to level up; the script buys them whenever you have enough cash.
· Redeem All Codes – Redeems every known code (including future ones) with a single click.
· Auto Buy ASMR Items – Multi‑select from the coin shop; buys when you can afford them, with live stock tracking and out‑of‑stock protection.
· Auto Buy Block Merchant Items – Same as above, but for block/category items.
· Auto Buy Gem Shop Items – Buys gem‑shop items when your gem balance allows (only appears if the gem shop remote is present).
· Auto Crafting – Choose a craftable item; the script auto‑crafts it when you have the required ingredients and cash.
· Auto Fuse – Select an item to fuse; starts new fuses when idle (needs enough copies and cash).
· Auto Claim Fuse – Independent toggle that automatically collects any completed fuse.
